description: Export presets and exports. add_preset writes a preset to export_presets.cfg with the keys the editor's Project > Export writes for a new one, every platform option left at its default, and makes it the platform's runnable preset when the platform has none. It answers where this engine's export templates belong and whether the preset's platform has them, since an export needs them; list says the same for every preset. An editor open on the project does not see a preset added this way until it restarts. run names, as alsoWritten, what else the export wrote beside its output, such as the .pck a Windows or Linux build cannot start without. Its entries are the errors and warnings the export printed, the newest two hundred distinct ones, one printed more than once carrying times, and errors and warnings count them; exported is true only when this run wrote the output and printed no error. Operations: list: the presets in export_presets.cfg; run (needs preset, outputPath): export with a preset; add_preset (needs preset, platform): add an export preset to export_presets.cfg.

debug.description: run: a debug export. Default false. Only for op run.

outputPath.description: Where the export is written, inside the project. The directory is created if it is not there: Godot's command-line exporter refuses a missing one with "The given export path doesn't exist", which reads as a wrong path in the preset. add_preset: the path the preset exports to from the editor, optional. Only for ops run, add_preset.

platform.description: add_preset: the platform the preset exports for. Only for op add_preset.

preset.description: Preset name from export_presets.cfg. add_preset: the name of the new one. Only for ops run, add_preset.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

name: project_export
title: Export
